'''Jonas Jacobsen''' (also published as '''Jonas Jacobson''') played the [[2018 European Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ 2018 European Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022022138/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2018-european-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]</ref> He also played the [[2025 Ninth Annual GEMPC]].<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-05-9th-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2025/ 2025 Ninth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref>
